The top horizontal airflow is labeled ①, the right vertical airflow is labeled ②, the horizontal airflow near the ground at the bottom is labeled ③, and the left vertical airflow is labeled ④. Then reason: the question stem states that this figure represents the mid-latitude circulation in the three-cell circulation, namely the Ferrel cell. The near-surface horizontal branch of the Ferrel cell corresponds to the mid-latitude westerlies. The near-surface horizontal branch in the figure is airflow ③, so the relatively humid one is airflow ③.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中四股气流构成一个环流圈，底部靠近地面的水平气流编号为③。再根据题干说明该图是“三圈环流”中的中纬环流，把它对应为费雷尔环流。费雷尔环流的近地面水平支就是中纬西风带，近地面气流容易从海洋或下垫面获得水汽，较湿润。因此图中较湿润的是③气流。

This is weakly distinct because it reaches the same identification through subtropical high/subpolar low structure rather than directly naming the surface westerlies.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the right vertical arrow ② as sinking from the upper right 丁 toward the lower right 乙, the left vertical arrow ④ as rising from lower left 甲 toward upper left 丙, the top arrow ① as high-level flow, and the bottom arrow ③ as the low-level flow connecting the descending side to the rising side.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text statement that the diagram is a middle-latitude circulation to assign the two sides of the cell to subtropical high and subpolar low belts, then answer the requested humid airflow.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: The middle-latitude circulation lies between the subtropical high-pressure belt and the subpolar low-pressure belt. Air descending in the subtropical high is relatively dry, upper-level flow is also not the main moist branch, while the low-level flow moving toward the subpolar low can carry abundant water vapor and feed frontal/rainy conditions.
